KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. mato
   B. watoto
   C. mitoto
   D. kitoto

2. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.

3. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.

4. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   C. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.

5. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.

6. When practising Kuzungumza:Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Kuzungumza:Msamiati.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Kuzungumza:Msamiati.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Kuzungumza:Msamiati.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kuzungumza:Msamiati.

7. When practising huyu na hawa, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to huyu na hawa.
   B. Copy random text without understanding huyu na hawa.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for huyu na hawa.
   D. Use insults to “practise” huyu na hawa.

8. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. zito
   B. fupi
   C. pana
   D. nene

9. When practising asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa., which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
   B. Avoid reading anything related to asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
   C. Copy random text without understanding asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
   D. Use insults to “practise” asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain huyu na hawa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

2. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.

9. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
